en.t: “Well then, please stay at our house.

units.source_text: 虽说委屈了，还是能睡得下的。”

en.t: It may be a little cramped, but there is still room enough to sleep.”

units.source_text: 道子说着换上了绢织和服，绕到庭院，仰望着修缮中的大雄宝殿笑了笑。

en.t: As she said this, Michiko changed into a silk kimono, went around to the garden, looked up at the main temple hall under repair, and smiled.
